description: Use this when the user wants the invoice for a fee pool of one of their funds emailed, usually to the manager who funds it, at an address they give. Starts the email. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed email for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_email_pool_invoice
title: Email a fee pool’s invoice
